title: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects… (CVE-2026-84234)
description: A vulnerability in LibreOffice Draw's PDF import feature allows an out-of-bounds write when processing images with transparency masks. This occurs because positions from crafted images are not properly validated against the image buffer size. The flaw can lead to memory corruption. Fixed versions limit image size and validate mask pixel positions before writing.
